title: Redundant Connection
statement: You are given a tree with one extra edge added, so the graph has n nodes numbered 1..n and exactly n edges. Exactly one cycle exists. Return the edge that can be removed to leave a tree. If several edges would work, return the one that appears last in the input.
constraints: the graph is connected and has exactly one cycle
no self-loops and no repeated edges
hints: Process the edges in order. The moment an edge joins two nodes that were already reachable from each other, that edge closed the cycle.
You need a structure that answers 'are these two already connected?' while you add edges one at a time.
Disjoint set union: a parent array, Find with path compression, Union by size. If Find(a) == Find(b) before you union, this edge is the answer.
